newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: RAGUTIS, GUBERNIJA SELL, MAKE MORE IN MAY.
newsitem.headline: RAGUTIS, GUBERNIJA SELL, MAKE MORE IN MAY.

text.p: The sales and production of the Ragutis and Gubernija breweries rose in May, the Breweries Association said on Wednesday.
The two companies are listed on the A list of the bourse.
The association said in a statement that Ragutis produced 127,000 decalitres of beer in May, a 19 percent increase over 107,000 decalitres in April.
It also said Ragutis sold 128,000 decalitres in May versus 106,000 litres in April and 86,000 decalitres were bottled.
Gubernija brewery produced 51,000 decalitres of beer in May, a sharp increase from 25,000 decalitres in April.
The sales of Gubernija also rose to 46,000 decalitres in May compared to 24,000 declitres a month before and 31,000 decalitres were bottled.
The association said earlier that the 10 biggest country's breweries produced 1.22 million decalitres and sold 1.19 million decalitres of beer in May.
It also said that 56,000 decalitres of beer went to exports and 960,000 decalitres were bottled.
